name: Phoenix-Lamar Corporation
old_description: Austin, Texas-based contract manufacturer of custom molded cable assemblies, electrical cables, and wire harnesses serving industrial, medical, and telecom clients.
about:
Phoenix-Lamar Corporation was founded in 1972 by Maitland Huffman in Austin, Texas. Huffman, an electronics enthusiast with multiple degrees, established the company as a family-oriented business focused on custom cable and wire harness manufacturing.

The company specializes in custom molded cable assemblies, electrical cables, and wire harnesses, offering in-house design, engineering, prototyping, injection molding, and turnkey assembly. Its production ranges from simple motherboard jumpers to complex 12-mile control cables, with every assembly undergoing 100% electrical testing.

Phoenix-Lamar serves industries including computer and electronics manufacturers, telecommunications, medical diagnostics, biomedical, instrumentation, traffic control, environmental testing, and contract manufacturers. Notable clients include National Instruments, which named the company Supplier of the Year.

The company emphasizes near-zero non-conforming assemblies, UL approval, and a quality system that separates inspection from production to ensure objectivity. Its culture stresses early deliveries, precision workmanship, and long-term employee retention, with many staff members staying for decades.
